questions.stem: What is the main function of the large intestine in the digestive process?

options.text: To absorb water from the remaining undigested material
To produce bile for fat digestion
To absorb glucose into the bloodstream
To digest remaining proteins and fats

questions.explanation: The large intestine absorbs water from the remaining undigested food material. This turns the liquid waste into solid faeces, which are then stored in the rectum before being egested.
